summary: Each year the University of Lausanne awards around ten Master's Scholarships to graduates of foreign universities with excellent results: CHF 1,600 a month for the minimum length of the master's, with standard registration fees waived. The scholarship application also counts as the master's application. Applications for 2027–28 closed on 1 November 2026, and the 2028–29 round opens in September 2027.
meta_title: Unil Master's Scholarship, Lausanne: CHF 1,600 a month
meta_description: The University of Lausanne gives about ten graduates of foreign universities CHF 1,600 a month for a master's, fees waived. Rules, documents, dates.
covers: CHF 1,600 a month for the minimum statutory length of the master's.
Exemption from the standard registration fees; only the CHF 80 semester fee remains.
eligibility: Graduates of a foreign university whose degree is recognised as equivalent to a Swiss bachelor's, with outstanding results.
C1 level in the language of the programme, French or English.
Not currently enrolled at Unil. Most master's programmes qualify; Medicine, most Law tracks, Health Sciences and a few others are excluded.
how_to_apply: Register online and upload a single PDF application by 1 November (for 2027–28 this closed on 1 November 2026).
Have two recommendation letters sent from professional email addresses to mastergrants@unil.ch by the same date.
If your diplomas come from a state that has not ratified the Lisbon Convention, post certified true copies by 1 November.
The scholarship application is also your master's application; decisions come in early April.
watch_out: Unil says CHF 1,600 a month does not cover the full cost of living in Switzerland, so it is not full funding.
Incomplete applications and applications sent by email are not considered.
costs: You, helped by CHF 1,600 a month
documents: A single PDF with the documents Unil lists
Two letters of recommendation sent directly by their authors
Certified true copies of diplomas and transcripts, if your country has not ratified the Lisbon Convention
